head: 1767e0267b290c61f2da4382feb8c5615bf6a4cf
mode: read-only design; no source edits and no broad corpus run

conclusion.verdict: Two real liveness false negatives. Do not solve them with @public, @orb-waive, a symbol-name allowlist, or a presence-only marker.
conclusion.architecture: Normalize external production consumption into one ExternalConsumption fact, but derive each fact from the source-native mechanism that actually consumes it.
conclusion.ownerRulingReason: The recommended arms extend already-ruled mechanisms: package scripts/tool entries are production entries, and a TypeScript satisfies witness is checked semantic source. A ruling is needed only if implementation instead adds a Bash parser dependency or a hand-maintained registry.

findings.mechanism: MATRIX_CONST is the string CHAT_VERB_AUTHORITY; the gate visitor selects that VariableDeclaration and resolveChatMatrix resolves its rows.

structuralEvidence.interpretation: The tool consumer is invisible because it deliberately holds the symbol name as a string.

findings.mechanism: Bash launches node --input-type=module -e; embedded ESM imports and calls buildVersionStamp to write /app/version.json.

structuralEvidence.bash: ast-grep --lang bash sees the whole environment-prefixed node command as one command node at line 84; the JavaScript is nested in its quoted -e argument.
structuralEvidence.textualCorroboration: rg found only the declaration, four test calls, and docker/assemble-runtime.sh:87.

existingMechanisms.reason: public-markers.ts:29-43 defines it for intentionally unconsumed exports, and the orphan ratchet reds it once production consumption exists.
They authorize exact verify-policy findings; external execution is evidence, not permission.
It already centralizes externally loaded entry conventions, but currently covers only package-root *.config.ts default exports.
prodonly.ts:25-49 already rules script targets/tool configs as production entries. It currently scans package manifests only and silently ignores missing script targets.

derivation: Find a string literal in a satisfies expression whose type is keyof typeof import(static-module).
Resolve the module with the TypeScript checker and the named export through barrels to its origin.
Require the carrier value to have a non-test use outside its declaration; otherwise refuse as detached evidence.
Credit exactly that origin as external-tooling consumption.
sourceReaderArm.staleness: A rename/removal is TypeScript-red and collector-refusal-red; comments and plain strings never create an edge.

shape: Move the inline node -e program into checked scripts/build-version-stamp.ts.
Use an ordinary static named import and call of buildVersionStamp.
Declare it in the root package.json scripts table and have assemble-runtime.sh invoke that named script.
derivation: Extend existing script-entry derivation to the root manifest.
A literal TS script target that does not resolve must refuse rather than disappear.
Follow its ordinary import graph; buildVersionStamp then needs no exception grammar.
launcherArm.reason: This avoids a Bash parser plus nested JavaScript parser for one current edge and reuses the checked TypeScript graph.

recommendedContract.bucketLaw: External edges enter usedTooling and usedProd only, never usedClientProd or usedServerProd.

coupledLenses.name: buildLiveness
coupledLenses.change: ingest normalized edges, record an external arm and exact sites

coupledLenses.name: apisurface
coupledLenses.change: its separate ApiConsumption map must ingest the same facts or it disagrees with orphans

coupledLenses.name: dead
coupledLenses.change: include exact external sites in TOOL-ANCHORED; semantic refs alone cannot see them

coupledLenses.name: chains
coupledLenses.change: add an outside-surface root consumer edge

coupledLenses.name: swallowed
coupledLenses.change: the external arm prevents namespace-only classification

coupledLenses.name: prodonly
coupledLenses.change: recognize root package script entries and fail loud for missing literal targets

coupledLenses.name: orphan export ratchet
coupledLenses.change: inherits both buildLiveness and collectApiSurface; both must agree in one commit

coupledLenses.name: clientgap
coupledLenses.change: preserve bucket boundaries; external tooling is neither server nor client product evidence

sourceReader: Exact export through named barrel re-exports credits only the origin.
Same literal in comments, ordinary strings, fixture strings or unrelated satisfies types credits nothing.
Missing module/export, ambiguity, nonliteral target and detached carrier refuse.
orphans, testonly, apisurface, dead, swallowed and chains agree on the same fixture.
launcher: Root package script points at a real TS entry that imports and calls the target.
An unregistered scripts/*.ts import is not an entry merely because of its directory.
assemble-runtime invokes the named script and produces version.json from the real server reader.
Removing the import/call makes the target test-only again; removing the target file with the manifest row present refuses.
redFirst: Old source classifies both targets api-test-only/testonly.
Fixed source classifies both tooling-public/production-consumed with exact sites and without promoting siblings.

alternatives.name: producer @external-consumer marker
alternatives.reason: Presence-only permission repeats the @public parking-permit failure.

alternatives.name: hand-written symbol/path allowlist
alternatives.reason: Names incidents rather than deriving the class and can silently rot.

alternatives.name: parse every shell node -e
alternatives.reason: Requires a Bash parser dependency plus nested JS parsing for one edge.

alternatives.name: type-only import solely to fool liveness
alternatives.reason: Can outlive the actual source reader and greens the lens without binding evidence to the consumed key.

alternatives.name: one normalized fact with source-native producers
alternatives.reason: Centralizes lens semantics while tying evidence to the actual mechanism.

implementationAssessment.reason: A truthful fix spans shared liveness, apisurface's independent map, dead, chains, prodonly/root entries, tests and both consumer sites. Editing one lens would make the fleet disagree.
